change.source: finding 2 (under the header the agent can answer a decision it sent itself to the person's inbox, and the design does not say whether that is intended): decided, no rule of the service refuses it. Version 1 has no scope narrower than the pair of a delegation, so an agent with a live delegation answers any message of the person's inbox in the person's place, one it sent itself included, and the record says the person answered; a sender that must not answer its own question holds no delegation of the person it asks. The design says so (docs/design/signing.md, A delegation) and the limits page names it (website/docs/limits.md); a scope on a delegation entry is a change of the key file's format and is not in this story
